decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - A scheme of construction phasing of development within Phase 1 and Phase 2 shall be submitted to and agreed by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall be implemented in accordance with that phasing scheme unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority. Phase 1 shall comprise the hotel, large retail unit, health and fitness centre, indoor children's play area, medical/dentistry centre, A3 bar/restaurant area nor greater than that indicated in the approved plans, private residential, key worker housing, the school works, 400 car parking spaces, the link road (excluding the western Douglas Road link), and Phase 2 shall comprise the remainder of the development including the child care facility.

Condition : 2 - Within six months of the date of this permission, or the first occupation of the medical centre, any area of A3 floorspace covered by this permission or the indoor children's play facility (whichever is the earlier); details of soundproofing measures to protect the residential occupiers of upper floors of the building from noise and vibration generated by the uses shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and the details so approved shall be implemented before the use commences.
description: Variation of Condition 2 of planning permission reference: 00616/F/P5 (Key Site 1) to allow for A3 Restaurant use at ground and first floor level.
